CustomField.description: Written by: the resolution stage (call 2 until the twenty-seventh stamp). Read by: the gates; Ambiguous routes to the Identification flag. Exactly one per located pair, which is the one-for-one-for-one arithmetic. None and Ambiguous are NOT abstention rows: they say what happened to a pair that exists, never that the transcript was silent. Merged (twenty-seventh stamp) says the pair's establishment rides another read's canonical row, both receipts kept - a disposition, so the arithmetic still counts it. Blank on a Located row, required on an Identified row.
CustomField.label: Disposition
